**Coaching note:**
After Qxg4+, the queen checks the king and controls escape squares. White's only legal move is Rg5, which blocks the check but leaves the rook undefended. Your queen can then capture it with checkmate—the king has no escape squares due to its own pawns and the remaining rook on e7. Always scan for forcing sequences (checks, captures) that lead to mate, not just material gain.
